question: Who launched the e-SeHAT application for accessible digital healthcare?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Omar Abdullah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Omar Abdullah**, the former Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, launched the **e-SeHAT application** aimed at providing accessible digital healthcare services.
 
• The initiative focuses on offering telemedicine services to patients, especially those residing in remote and underserved areas.
 
• The e-SeHAT application aims to bridge the gap between patients and healthcare providers by ensuring consultation services through digital platforms.
 
• It is designed to enhance healthcare delivery, reduce the burden on physical healthcare facilities, and ensure timely medical advice.
 
• Omar Abdullah played a pivotal role in promoting technological advancements and digital infrastructure in the healthcare sector during his tenure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhupendra Patel**:

 
 
• Bhupendra Patel is the current Chief Minister of Gujarat.
 
• He has spearheaded various development programs in Gujarat, including infrastructure projects and initiatives for education and agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Hemant Soren**:
 
 
• Hemant Soren is the Chief Minister of Jharkhand.
 
• He has focused on social welfare programs, tribal upliftment, and schemes to improve healthcare and education in Jharkhand.
 
 
 
• **Pema Khandu**:
 
 
• Pema Khandu is the Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• He has worked on promoting regional connectivity and enhancing digital infrastructure in the state.
